cross_page_pattern_observation.note: Engagement does NOT scale with follower count across the now-8-post live-verified sample. SpyEstates (~210K followers, investigative/news-style content) got the highest engagement of any page (21 reactions + 8 comments + 3 shares). Bahn Mahanakorn (~110K followers, home-building, behind-the-scenes video) got 9 reactions + 2 shares + 164 views. Bangkok Asset (~350K followers, direct project-promo) got only 5 reactions + 448 views. HOME888 (~120K followers, geo-focused round) got 3 reactions + 1,700 views on a plain amenity-proximity listing video — again a large follower base without correspondingly large reaction counts. Mahanakornhome, CS Property, and Home.ban2 (all small pages, plain listing formats) got 1-3 reactions and effectively zero comments/shares each. This is now an 8-post comparison across 8 pages, not a statistically validated finding, but the pattern is consistent enough across a growing sample to treat as a real signal: news/announcement or behind-the-scenes/trust-building framing appears to outperform plain price-listing posts, regardless of the page's follower count.
cross_page_pattern_observation.second_finding: Three independent pages (CS Property, Home.ban2, and now HOME888 — spanning small, medium, and large follower counts) have all used the same transit/amenity-proximity hook pattern ("near BTS/MRT line, near a named mall, near a major road") — suggesting this is a common, low-effort format used across resale operators of every size, not a differentiated one. Worth noting as a pattern Finnhouses should expect virtually all competitors to already be using, not a novel angle to claim as a differentiator.

limitation_note: 8 live-verified posts collected across 8 pages (out of 20+ candidates now tracked, including the geo-focused Nonthaburi/Pathum Thani additions), not 50 posts x 20 pages (1,000 data points) as the original spec requests. Facebook's page feed only rendered 1-2 real posts per page before further scroll attempts returned loading skeletons that didn't resolve within a reasonable wait — closing this gap fully would need either repeated retries per page over a longer session, or the Nimble scraping connector once authenticated. Several candidate pages remain fully unchecked via live browser (FazWaz's per-post engagement, Estopolis.com, Realist, prop2morrow, Living Sneak Peek, CondoDiary, Review by O, Passion Realtor, plus บ้านมือสองนนทบุรี by รักบ้าน and คุณนัท from the geo-focused round).
